newsitem.title: USA: Buckeye to up payout after ESOP restructure. [CORRECTED 22:25 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Buckeye to up payout after ESOP restructure. [CORRECTED 22:25 GMT]

text.p: Buckeye Management Co, general partner of Buckeye Partners LP, set a regular quarterly partnership cash distribution of $.75 per unit and said it would boost that to $0.85 per unit after it restructured its employee stock ownership plan.
The board announced plans to restructure the General Partner's employee stock ownership plan in December.
This would reduce the cost of maintaining the employee stock ownership plan, it said.
After implementing the restructured plan, Buckeye said it would increase its quarterly cash distribution payment to $0.85 per unit.
The regular $0.75 per unit distribution was payable February 28 (corrects from February 23) to unitholders of record on February 21, it said.
